note: The passport fees effective 12 February 2018 as the Embassy in Washington publishes them: $100.00 and ten years from age 13, $50.00 and five years for infants and children 12 and under. The $50.00 expedited fee is granted only for a family emergency of life or death, with a death certificate or a doctor's letter, so it is not modelled as a route anyone can buy. A lost or damaged passport costs $200 or $100 including a penalty, written as a replacement route. The processing time is a lead.
